profile.Name: Green
profile.Personality: Smart, boastful, and easygoing. He claims few in the Swamp can shoot as well as he does, but he feels he failed his crew and has let bar life grow on him.
profile.Backstory: Crossbowman. He honed his shooting at a smuggler base until Skull Collectors wiped out his crew. Now he drinks in a bar in the Swamp and owes a large bar tab.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Casual and cocky, dropping his g's ('shootin'', 'workin'') and swearing freely. He likes to propose wagers.
